eventDetail.scope: AIBDSG 2026 will serve as an international academic forum dedicated to advances in computational intelligence, informatics, and big data. The conference will focus on three main areas: Applied Computational Intelligence (including machine learning, deep learning, evolutionary computing, neural networks, and intelligent optimization); Informatics (including information processing, data analysis, information security, bioinformatics, and multi-source information fusion); and Big Data (including big data processing, mining, storage, cloud-based technologies, and privacy protection). AIBDSG 2026 will organize keynote speeches, technical sessions, and workshops to share frontier insights and build global cooperation platforms. We sincerely welcome researchers and experts from around the world to participate in the conference, share cutting-edge achievements, address key challenges, strengthen industry-academia collaboration, and promote technological innovation in related fields.
